hypothesis: Forecast every prospective member VM, including incoming VMs, using only that VM's earlier demand samples; sum CPU MIPS before destination admission.
model: Existing frozen robust/persistence learner reused per VM; 20 resolved pairs, min10, five-minute horizon. VM identity carries its history across moves. No parameter tuning.
causality: Samples recorded in existing demand observation loop without extra simulator events; only samples strictly before the planning time can train. Training pairs require 300s spacing within1s. No trace future reads.
control: Same numeric source/destination demand packing, same physical filters, same observations, current demand only. Existing host-level overload model unchanged.
admission: Conservative maximum of current prospective demand and summed VM forecast; retains physical CPU/RAM/BW/storage. No completion schedule knowledge.
inputs: Five already inspected cases, development study only; no reserved data.
acceptance: observe-only control matches earlier control CSV
